title: Commercial Director
description: QLM Search are partnering with a high-growth, branded food manufacturing group to appoint an outstanding Commercial Director to lead the next phase of strategic and commercial development. This is a pivotal executive role, responsible for shaping and delivering a best-in-class commercial agenda across marketing and sales, driving both brand equity and revenue growth in highly competitive markets. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will own the full commercial strategy, with accountability for both world-class brand building and high-performing sales execution. This role requires a rare blend of strategic marketing excellence and proven sales leadership, with the ability to translate insight-led brand strategies into tangible commercial outcomes. You will lead and inspire multidisciplinary teams across marketing, category, and sales, ensuring alignment behind a clear growth vision and delivering sustainable, profitable expansion across key channels.

title: Supply Chain Director
description: QLM Search is retained by a leading UK food manufacturer to appoint a Supply Chain Director. This is a leadership role with full responsibility for the end-to-end supply chain across a complex manufacturing operation. The Supply Chain Director will ensure the supply chain is structured, controlled and capable of supporting both current performance and future growth. This role offers genuine autonomy to shape and develop the supply chain function, providing the opportunity to build lasting capability and make a visible impact within a growing and complex food manufacturing business. ‍

title: Chief Executive Officer
description: QLM Search are supporting the Board of a highly respected flavours and ingredients business on the appointment of a new Chief Executive Officer.

title: Supply Chain Director (North America)
description: QLM Search is partnering with a global FMCG manufacturer with a dominant North American footprint, strong market positions, and clear momentum for growth and operational evolution. This is a senior, highly visible opportunity to lead the supply chain for the organisation’s largest division, with an extensive manufacturing site footprint across North America delivering ultra high-volumes to the markets. You will be stepping into a role with genuine licence to evolve the function -modernising planning, strengthening supply resilience, and leading the transition toward automation and AI-enabled supply chain capabilities. ‍

title: Head of Sales & Commercial
description: QLM Search is working in partnership with Pickstock Telford to appoint a Head of Sales & Commercial, a senior leadership role with full accountability for the commercial direction, performance, and capability of the business. This is an end-to-end commercial position. You will lead Sales, Commercial Planning and pricing strategy, shaping how the business trades today while building a more resilient, data-led and integrated commercial function for the future.

title: Sales Director
description: QLM Search is partnering a specialist ingredients group that is looking to appoint a Sales Director. Reporting to the VP Sales and forming part of a the leadership team, the role will be instrumental in delivering their 5 year commercial strategy in this specialist division.

title: Chief Executive Officer
description: QLM Search are supporting the Board of a highly respected, international flavours and ingredients business on the appointment of a new Chief Executive Officer. This is a rare opportunity to lead a purpose-led, science-driven organisation with a long heritage, deep technical expertise and a strong reputation across global beverage, flavour house and food customers. The business operates internationally, with significant manufacturing, innovation and commercial capability across Europe and North America, and is at an important point in its evolution. Substantial investment has been made in people, facilities and innovation. The next CEO will play a defining role in converting this platform into sustained commercial performance and long-term value creation.

title: Group Engineering Director - Europe
description: Our client is a leading force in red meat production, operating a complex network of beef processing facilities supported by a range of strategic joint ventures across complementary food categories across Europe. With a reputation built on quality, innovation, and trusted partnerships, the group continues to invest heavily in technology, capability, and people to secure long-term growth. This is a senior leadership position offering significant influence and scope. The Group Engineering Director will take full responsibility for setting and delivering the organisation’s engineering and asset management strategy across all sites and joint ventures. ‍

title: Chief Financial Officer
description: QLM Search is partnering with a highly respected, privately held Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) Group embarking on an ambitious growth agenda. To support this accelerated expansion and transformation, the business is seeking to appoint an experienced and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to play a pivotal leadership role in shaping the company’s financial future. The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and a strategic partner to the CEO and Board. This role carries full accountability for the finance function, with a strong emphasis on Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) as a driver of business insights and strategic decision-making. The successful candidate will be a hands-on executive who transforms financial data into clear, actionable insights that influence operational and commercial priorities. They will build and lead an FP&A capability that provides timely, accurate forecasting, scenario analysis, and performance measurement across the business portfolio. ‍

title: Finance Director
description: QLM Search is working in partnership with a leading Food / Beverage / B2B Group that is looking to appoint a UK Finance Director. With strong year-on-year growth, significant investment, and an ambitious strategic roadmap, the business is poised for accelerated expansion in the UK. This is more than a finance role, it’s a leadership position central to the UK business and its future growth. As Finance Director, you will be the trusted strategic partner to the UK CEO , providing first-class insight, challenge, and direction. You’ll combine big-picture strategic thinking with operational excellence, ensuring the basics are executed brilliantly while enabling the business to capture growth opportunities at pace. You will also lead the IT function , including project managing the implementation of a new ERP system designed to transform operational capability and scale the business for future growth. Additionally, you will support the EMEA CEO by delivering ad-hoc finance projects and analyses that guide regional strategy and decision-making. ‍

title: Head of International Trading - Meat & Seafood
description: Our client is a leading international food group with deep roots in the UK and Ireland, and an established reputation across Europe. The group has built its success on a combination of innovation, strong supply chain integration, and long-term customer relationships. It is now seeking a senior commercial leader to drive the next stage of its international meat and seafood trading growth. As Head of International Trading (Meat & Seafood), you will take full responsibility for developing and expanding the company’s trading activities across global markets. This role is about scale, influence, and opportunity, balancing strategic leadership with commercial execution. ‍

title: Group Manufacturing Director - UK & Ireland
description: Our client is a leading international food group with a proud heritage and ambitious future. Operating at significant scale, with a portfolio of recognised brands and trusted partnerships across retail, foodservice, and export markets. With a network of modern facilities across the UK and Ireland, and a workforce of several thousand colleagues, the business has built a reputation for quality, innovation, and responsibility. Today, it is investing heavily in automation, digital transformation, and modernisation while continuing to deliver safe, affordable, high-quality food to millions of consumers. We are seeking an exceptional leader to join the leadership team as Group Manufacturing Director (UK & Ireland) . ‍

title: SVP IT
description: A global, publicly listed organisation FMCG Group is seeking a Senior Vice President of Information Technology to lead its enterprise-wide technology agenda. This newly created role will report at Group Executive level and provide strategic oversight of IT across Finance, HR, Supply Chain, and Shared Services. The successful candidate will shape and execute a multi-year technology roadmap that underpins business transformation, digital enablement and operational excellence across a complex international footprint. ‍

title: S4/Hana Programme Director
description: QLM Search is partnering a highly innovative FTSE 100 Manufacturer embarking on a business-critical SAP S/4HANA greenfield transformation programme. To lead this initiative, we are seeking a highly capable Programme Director with a deep understanding of SAP systems, a track record of delivering complex global programmes, and a practical grasp of operational change across large organisations. The successful candidate will be responsible for end-to-end delivery from programme definition and technical integration through to stakeholder engagement and post-implementation. This is a leadership role requiring hands-on direction of cross-functional teams, control of a sizeable budget, and clear communication with global business stakeholders. ‍

title: Sales Director
description: QLM Search is partnering with a leading specialist Ingredients group with a Sales Director (EMEA) hire in a specialist category. The business is a fast growth leader in providing niche solutions to Beverage and Food Groups. They require a proven Sales Director with a focus on the EMEA region to create and drive the customer strategy to maximise sales growth.

title: Managing Director - Ireland
description: Our client, a Global Food Group is partnering QLM Search to appoint a Managing Director - Ireland Reporting to the Chief Executive, you will be responsible for setting strategic objectives and driving business performance across the Irish Market. ‍

title: Senior Data Strategy Director
description: Our client helps people live healthier, happier lives—and data drives every decision made, from product innovation to supply-chain excellence. They’re looking for a commercially minded Data Strategy Senior Director to turn rich information into real-world value.

title: Managing Director - European
description: Our client, a Global Food Group is partnering QLM Search to appoint a European Managing Director. Reporting to the Chief Executive, you will be responsible for setting strategic objectives and driving business performance across all European Markets. ‍

Reporting to the CEO, you will fulfil a unique position in the group, focusing on key strategic projects and M&A ventures. This newly created role will play a critical role in the business executing its exciting growth agenda. ‍

This is a fantastic position to support the long-term strategy of multiple business units and with a global growth agenda in a large and complex business.

The business is a leader in providing world class ingredients solutions to major Food & Beverage Groups. They require a proven commercial leader that can create and drive the customer strategy to maximise sales growth and margin for three of their largest accounts.
